_comment: Edge functions whose PRODUCTION artifact comes from an unmerged branch. A held function is never uploaded by the deploy workflow (push or manual redeploy) and is never reported as proven: every run prints it as HELD with the reason below. A hold is removed only by a reviewed PR, normally the PR that merges the source branch, in the same change. Evidence for each entry must be the exact deployed artifact, not an assumption.

holds.reason: Production v55 runs the Design Studio walkthrough from an unmerged branch: 98/98 deployed files are byte-identical to the source commit, while main matches only 74 (13 differ, 11 absent, e.g. src/lib/designStudio/walkthrough/readingRepair.ts, geometryCheck.ts, renderPlan.ts). Deploying it from main would replace that implementation with an older one.
holds.release: Remove this entry in the PR that merges the source branch (or a reconciled successor), so that its first deploy from main carries the Design Studio code.
